entries.definition: A structured representation tied to one source identity and its scientific coordinates.
entries.usage_rule: Defined once in Methods; do not imply raw-text extraction.

entries.definition: The candidate decision rule that tests claim-required coordinate relations.
entries.usage_rule: Use for the mechanism; the observed confirmatory discrimination is polarity-only.

entries.definition: Registered comparator that merges when normalized predicates match.
entries.usage_rule: Never call it a current state-of-the-art system.

entries.definition: Registered false-split control that accepts only exact exposed-coordinate equality and may abstain.
Outcome used when required information or authority is absent.
entries.usage_rule: Not a negative decision and not a machine token.

entries.definition: A compatible prediction for a gold non-merge relation.
A non-merge prediction for a gold compatible relation.
entries.usage_rule: Abstention is separately counted, not a false split.

entries.definition: No repeated case identifiers between initial and confirmatory sets.
entries.usage_rule: Do not shorten to source-disjoint; two source records recur.

entries.definition: Standard-library verifier that does not import original analysis code.
entries.usage_rule: Same repository and custody; not external replication.

entries.definition: Structured cases derived from pinned public resources or deterministic standards.
entries.usage_rule: Not a newly commissioned expert gold atlas.
